messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: pg-main connections high (95% of max_connections), p95 query latency 2.4s, idle connections piling. Alert: DB_CONN_POOL_EXHAUSTION. Pager: pagerduty

jordan.ops: acked. Seeing the PD page. grabbing metrics now.

pagerduty: Acknowledged by jordan.ops. Escalation to L2 in 5m if not resolved.

jordan.ops: quick snapshot from grafana -> connections spike started ~02:12 UTC, sustained. pgbouncer stats show > max_client_limit hits.

chris-db: +1. Possible leak or flapping long transactions. Can someone check `pg_stat_activity` for long running txns?

lee-eng: running query now, will paste results.

lee-eng: ```sql
SELECT pid, usename, state, query_start, now() - query_start AS age, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state != 'idle'
ORDER BY age DESC
LIMIT 15;
```

lee-eng: output: ```
pid | usename   | state  | age     | query
----+-----------+--------+---------+------------------------------------
12053 | metrics | active | 00:25:12 | COPY metrics_collector ...
11987 | api     | active | 00:23:41 | UPDATE job_status ...
11800 | inference | active | 00:03:12 | SELECT ...
```

maria-sre: note: impact: some Redwood API ops (sync inference calls) are seeing 500s and spikes. Support ticket volume slowly rising. Marking SEV2 until we have customer impact number. @tara-support can you triage top customer errors?

tara-support: on it. early: 3 customers reporting timeouts from the hosted API, region us-west1. Escalating to CS lead.

jordan.ops: mitigation plan: (1) reduce pgbouncer `max_client_conn` enforcement? not ideal. (2) identify and kill runaway COPY from metrics_collector. (3) temporarily route non-critical traffic to read-replica for safe reads. which is fastest?

chris-db: killing long COPY will free a bunch of connections. but we should also throttle the metrics job so it doesn't restart immediately. I'll take SQL kill + coordinate restart.

lee-eng: kill command: ```sql
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(12053);
```

chris-db: executed `pg_terminate_backend(12053)` at 02:20:13 UTC. Waiting for connections to drop.

olm-performance-bot: pgbouncer: active_clients decreased from 890 -> 150 in 23s after termination. avg p95 latency down to 480ms.

jordan.ops: nice, seeing latency drop on traces. PagerDuty: update - still open but acknowledged by L1.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation suppressed because alert condition cleared. Monitor for re-fire.

maria-sre: interim: set sev = SEV2 -> SEV3 pending. @tara-support please verify customer sessions recovered.

tara-support: customers confirm service recovery for 2/3. One customer (acct-omega) still seeing intermittent 504s; digging into their region routing.

lee-eng: checking connection origin: metrics_collector's IP shows heavy connection reuse pattern. Looks like a bug in the collector batching when a previous COPY hangs. I see same pid showing repeated reconnects in logs.

chris-db: created temporary mitigation: scaled metrics-collector down to 0 replicas (killed job) at 02:26:02 UTC, and applied rate-limit to collector in config. Also bumped pgbouncer `reserve_pool_size` by 50 to give headroom.

jordan.ops: applied pgbouncer config change via CLI: ```bash
redispatch pgbouncer reload-config --instance pg-main
# showed: config reloaded
```

olm-performance-bot: p95 latency now 210ms, active connections stable ~120. No new errors in last 2m.

maria-sre: good. I'll take handoff: preparing incident doc and will open a follow-up JIRA for root cause and permanent mitigation (metrics collector fix + acceptance tests). @chris-db can you draft recommended pgbouncer limits?

chris-db: will do. initial notes: enforce max_client_conn properly, add health-check to collector for COPY operations, add circuit-breaker in collector.

jordan.ops: log snippets from app error stream where it failed: ```
[02:14:48] ERROR inference-runtime: failed to acquire connection: timeout after 5s
[02:15:02] WARN api-gateway: upstream connect error: connection refused
```

maria-sre: customer impact: tagged 3 customers with transient errors, no data loss. internal ETA for RCA ticket: 2 days. Postmortem owner: chris-db.

tara-support: updated customers, one arranged follow-up call for root-cause. CS confirmed no SLA credit required at this time.

jordan.ops: final ops note: restarted pgbouncer at 02:34:11 UTC to pick up reserve_pool change. Verified no connection thrash afterwards.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved (condition cleared) at 02:35:42 UTC. No open pages.

maria-sre: closing the live thread. Action items: 1) chris-db to submit RCA + patch for collector (due +48h). 2) infra to add alert suppression to avoid noisy-refire for known transient collector copies. 3) run chaos test simulating collector failures and verify pgbouncer headroom.

chris-db: ack. I'll post a short timeline in the RCA ticket.

jordan.ops: thanks everyone. tagging this for postmortem review on Monday ops sync. :thumbsup:
